features.quote: Token budget: 200k tokens (input + output) per run. Hard kill at breach.
Hard loop kill: If the exact same bash command is issued 3 times in a row with no file edits in between, kill at that turn and mark as degraded. Saves ~30% of tokens in Tier S.
features.justification_quote: Saves ~30% of tokens in Tier S.

features.quote: Turn 15 checkpoint: Compute automated DI_heuristic. If DI_heuristic < 3.0 and the agent has made ≥3 distinct, non-cyclical edits, continue to turn 40
features.justification_quote: Implement automated capping to avoid paying for 40 turns of pure noise

features.quote: Turn 25 checkpoint: If DI_heuristic > 6.5, allow run to continue to 40 for severity measurement, but flag as degraded for preliminary reporting.
features.justification_quote: Implement automated capping to avoid paying for 40 turns of pure noise
